united-kingdom-nmc.headline: Nursing in the United Kingdom (NMC CBT & OSCE Hub)
united-kingdom-nmc.subheadline: Master NMC Future Nurse standards, Part A Numeracy, Part B Clinical CBT, APIE OSCE stations, NICE guidelines, and UK SI laboratory units.

sections.title: 1. UK NMC Test of Competence Structure (CBT & OSCE)

blocks.text: Every internationally educated nurse seeking UK registration with the **Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC)** completes **Part 1: Computer-Based Test (CBT)** at a Pearson VUE center, followed by **Part 2: Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE)** in the UK.

blocks.title: UK NMC Registration & Examination Sequence
blocks.caption: From NMC eligibility and CBT numeracy/theory to the 10-station UK OSCE.

steps.label: CBT Part A
steps.detail: 15 clinical numeracy & IV math questions (30 mins)

steps.label: NMC PIN Issued
steps.detail: Enter UK Register & begin NHS preceptorship

blocks.title: NMC CBT & OSCE Exam Blueprint Overview
rows: 15 short-answer calculation items (oral tablets, IV mL/hr, mg/kg, fluid balance).
Zero rounding errors — read exact decimal instructions
100 MCQs aligned to **Future Nurse: Standards of Proficiency (2018)**.
**NMC Code:** Prioritize people, practice effectively, preserve safety
4 APIE (Assessment, Planning, Implementation, Evaluation) + 4 clinical skills + 2 evidence/values stations.

sections.title: 2. UK vs. Uganda/US Drug Terminology & SI Lab Reference

blocks.title: High-Yield UK NHS Naming & SI Units
rows: Max adult dose **4 g / 24 hours**; watch hepatotoxicity.
Anaphylaxis adult IM dose: **0.5 mg (0.5 mL of 1:1000)**.
Standard UK **BNF** generic naming on OSCE charts.
Hypoglycemia threshold in UK adults: **< 4.0 mmol/L** (treat fast!).

quiz.prompt: In the UK NHS/NMC OSCE, a patient's capillary blood glucose drops to 3.4 mmol/L and they are conscious and able to swallow safely. What is the immediate priority?
options: Administer 15–20 g of fast-acting oral carbohydrate and recheck in 10–15 minutes
Document and recheck during the next 4-hourly observations
Place the patient nil by mouth and wait for a doctor
quiz.rationale: In UK NICE/NHS hypoglycemia management, < 4.0 mmol/L in a conscious patient requires immediate 15–20 g fast-acting oral carbohydrate followed by a repeat glucose check at 10–15 minutes.

quiz.prompt: Which 4-station sequence forms the core patient-scenario backbone of the UK NMC OSCE?
quiz.rationale: The UK NMC OSCE evaluates structured holistic nursing across the 4 linked APIE stations: Assessment, Planning, Implementation, and Evaluation.

united-states-nclex.headline: Nursing in the United States (NCLEX-RN & CGFNS Hub)
united-states-nclex.subheadline: Master NCSBN Next-Gen Clinical Judgment (CJMM), US conventional lab units (mg/dL, mEq/L), high-alert pharmacology, and prioritization rules.

blocks.text: The **Next-Generation NCLEX-RN (NGN)** evaluates safe entry-level practice across **Client Needs** categories and the 6-step **NCSBN Clinical Judgment Measurement Model (CJMM)** using evolving case studies, matrix grids, bowtie items, and trend questions.

blocks.title: NCSBN 6-Step Clinical Judgment Loop
blocks.caption: Every NGN case study tests these six sequential clinical reasoning steps.

steps.label: Recognize Cues
steps.detail: Spot abnormal vitals, labs & patient changes

steps.label: Take Action & Evaluate
steps.detail: Intervene first, then verify patient response

blocks.title: NCLEX Prioritization & Delegation Rules
rows: Always secure **airway patency** before breathing, and breathing before circulation.
SpO2 86% -> raise HOB & give O2 before charting
New sudden deterioration beats expected chronic findings.
Sudden confusion in COPD patient beats baseline productive cough
New chest pain beats scheduled discharge teaching
RNs **never delegate EAT** (Evaluation, Assessment, Teaching) or unstable clients.
**UAP:** routine vitals on stable patients, bathing, I&O
**RN:** IV push, blood transfusion initiation, initial teaching

sections.title: 2. US Conventional Lab Values (mg/dL, mEq/L) & High-Alert Antidotes

blocks.title: Must-Know US NCLEX Normal Ranges & Antidotes
rows: Never push IV KCl; watch peaked T-waves if K+ > 5.0.
Note: US uses **mg/dL** (divide by 18 for Uganda/UK mmol/L).
Monitor **PT/INR** for Warfarin; **aPTT** for IV Heparin.
Hold MgSO4 if **RR < 12–16**, absent DTRs, or urine < 30 mL/hr.

quiz.prompt: On a US medical-surgical unit, which task can the Registered Nurse (RN) safely delegate to an Unlicensed Assistive Personnel (UAP)?
options: Administering IV push furosemide to a heart failure client
Obtaining routine morning vital signs for a stable post-op Day 2 client
Performing the initial admission assessment on a new stroke client
Teaching insulin injection technique prior to discharge
quiz.rationale: Routine vital signs on a stable client fall within UAP scope; RNs never delegate assessment, teaching, or IV push medications.

quiz.prompt: A US client receiving IV Heparin has an aPTT of 118 seconds (therapeutic 60–80 sec) and oozing from the IV site. Which reversal medication should the nurse prepare?
quiz.rationale: Protamine sulfate is the specific antidote for Heparin toxicity; Vitamin K reverses Warfarin.

canada-nnas-nclex.eyebrow: CANADA NURSING ACADEMY · NNAS · NCLEX-RN & REx-PN
canada-nnas-nclex.headline: Nursing in Canada (NNAS, NCLEX-RN & REx-PN Hub)
canada-nnas-nclex.subheadline: Master NNAS credential evaluation, provincial CNO/BCCNM/CRNA competencies, NCLEX-RN & REx-PN exam strategies, and Canadian SI lab ranges.

blocks.text: Internationally educated nurses apply through **NNAS (National Nursing Assessment Service)** before seeking registration with a provincial regulator such as **CNO (Ontario)**, **BCCNM (British Columbia)**, or **CRNA (Alberta)**.

blocks.title: Canada IEN Pathway (NNAS to Licensure)
blocks.caption: Five core stages from NNAS verification to provincial RN or RPN/LPN practice.

steps.label: NNAS File
steps.detail: Verify education, Uganda UNMC license & experience

steps.label: Advisory Report
steps.detail: Submit NNAS report to CNO, BCCNM or CRNA

steps.label: Competency Review
steps.detail: Meet English, jurisprudence & bridging if required

blocks.title: NCLEX-RN vs. REx-PN & Canadian SI Lab Notes
rows: Uses **same NCSBN NGN format** as USA
Expect **SI Lab Units** (`mmol/L`, `µmol/L`, `g/L`) on Canadian questions
Registered Practical Nurses (Ontario CNO) & LPNs (BC BCCNM).
Focuses on stable/predictable client care, medication safety & collaboration
CNO/BCCNM Clinician, Communicator, Collaborator, Leader, Scholar roles.
Cultural safety, informed consent & interprofessional SBAR escalation

quiz.prompt: Which two Canadian provincial nursing regulators jointly administer the REx-PN exam for practical nurses?
quiz.rationale: The REx-PN was jointly developed by the College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO) and British Columbia College of Nurses and Midwives (BCCNM) with NCSBN.

australia-ahpra-nmba.eyebrow: AUSTRALIA NURSING ACADEMY · AHPRA / NMBA OBA
australia-ahpra-nmba.headline: Nursing in Australia (Ahpra & NMBA OBA Hub)
australia-ahpra-nmba.subheadline: Master the Ahpra Outcomes-Based Assessment (OBA): Stage 1 NCLEX-RN, Stage 2 Australian OSCE, NMBA Standards for Practice, and SI lab units.

blocks.text: Under **Ahpra** and the **Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA)**, Stream B internationally qualified nurses complete the two-stage **Outcomes-Based Assessment (OBA)**: **Stage 1 NCLEX-RN** followed by **Stage 2 Clinical OSCE** in Australia.

blocks.title: Ahpra / NMBA Stream B OBA Sequence
blocks.caption: Two-stage assessment combining NCLEX-RN clinical judgment and Australian OSCE practice.

steps.label: Ahpra Self-Check
steps.detail: Verify UNMC qualification & Stream B placement

steps.label: Stage 1: NCLEX-RN
steps.detail: Pass cognitive exam via Pearson VUE

blocks.title: Australian NMBA Standards & Clinical Keynotes
rows: 7 interconnected standards: critical thinking, therapeutic relationships, capability, safe practice, evaluation.
Always explain procedures, verify **3 patient identifiers**, and obtain verbal consent
Uses **SI units (`mmol/L`)** and Australian Approved Names (*Paracetamol*, *Adrenaline*, *Lignocaine*).
Same **Paracetamol / Adrenaline** conventions familiar from Uganda & UK training
Aseptic non-touch technique, medication rights, falls/pressure prevention & escalation.
Verbalize hand hygiene (**5 Moments**) & allergy checks clearly to examiners

quiz.prompt: In Australia's Ahpra/NMBA Outcomes-Based Assessment (OBA) for Registered Nurses, what are the two examination stages?
options: CBT Numeracy followed by NNAS Advisory Report
Stage 1 NCLEX-RN (cognitive) followed by Stage 2 OSCE (behavioural)
quiz.rationale: Stream B candidates complete Stage 1 (NCLEX-RN cognitive exam) and Stage 2 (Australian NMBA OSCE behavioural exam).
